text:
Senior Security Engineer at NexaSecure Tech, shaping secure systems in a startup environment. Over the past six years, I’ve focused on building resilient infrastructure and mitigating risks in fast-paced tech ecosystems.  

Application security with OWASP frameworks has been central to my work, ensuring robust defenses for cloud-native apps. Designing VPC architectures and subnet strategies helped scale our platform while maintaining network isolation. Compliance with SOC2 and GDPR standards became a priority as we grew, balancing innovation with regulatory trust.  

IAM frameworks and access control models are daily priorities, refining policies to align with business needs without compromising security. Incident response has been a critical skill, especially during high-stakes breaches, where quick containment was key.  

Leveraging SIEM tools to monitor endpoints and detect anomalies has refined our proactive approach. Threat modeling sessions with cross-functional teams now shape product security from the outset. Regular vulnerability assessments keep our systems ahead of emerging risks.  

I thrive in environments where security isn’t an afterthought but a foundational design principle. Building systems that are both agile and secure remains my focus.
